title: learning to save in a mall world discount store.
content: when I was in a pawnshop or donation store before this morning, I saw a dvd in a white plastic dvd cover that was for sale. I didn't know for how much though. at the time. it was a dimly lit white interior store with bookshelves, to make it to look like a book library with central seating for reading near the sides of the bookshelves there. I decided to go to a register man behind a long see through display case counter. Two short lines of people were there, sort of, to pay for their items from there, at two cash registers there. when I handed over the white covering, dvd, for my turn to pay, I waited from him for a few moments, while still not knowing how much the dvd for a movie maybe costed; I had maybe seven dollars or more in money to pay for it. He later told me that it costed $75 dollars. I wanted to be sure that it wasn't for maybe 75 cents instead, but he turned his little laptop around,.. and showed that it sort of costed $75 dollars instead of being for 75 cents. so I put my money away and decided to turn away to the front of the store and to leave. after I decided against 'bothering thoughts' of to keep all of my money while I was waking up, I told the bothersome thoughts no, and that I wanted to keep the money I had for me. I felt better in my lungs or heart,.. then things got brighter as I woke up. when I finally came from washing up after using the bathroom, and came to turn on my cellphone to think about writing about all of this, the cell phone showed me that it was 7:11 am, here at eastern standard times. Instead of going into applications on the cellphone to write this out to you all, today, I decided to write about this on a long half of a sheet of paper that I found locked inside of my notebook, instead, which helped me to remember more visual accounts about the dream place, strangely, without tv being on yet. Later I will go to the library close by cerca de aqui to rewrite all of this there. take care until later, you all. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . hello again, it is 12:09 pm,.. here at the library, after the end of writing my story again, take care you all,.. and I hope that things will cost less in the coming days, and that Life on Earth, will get better.
